notices.title: Remote upper Green River

takeOutAccess.sourceName: Wyoming Game and Fish river-access record, corroborated by current Forest Service site and motor-vehicle maps
takeOutAccess.note: WGFD feature 21 lists launch and take-out access. The current USFS site page lists Site Open, Recreation.gov lists canoeing/water access, and the official campground layout matches the river bend and campground loop in imagery. The USFS coordinate identifies the entrance-road junction about 500 metres from the WGFD campground access area, not a competing shoreline landing. The current 2026 motor-vehicle map shows the campground spur; older EDW openstatus=closed is superseded here by the current site page and updated IVM record.
takeOutAccess.directions: Follow the signed Whiskey Grove Campground turnoff from Forest Road 600 into the campground. The Area marker is near the river within the campground; the Forest Service website coordinate is at the entrance-road junction. Scout a usable public carry and landing without blocking campsites. The main approach has an April 15–December 15 motor-vehicle season; check current conditions and signs.
